Gothic 1 Remake is NOW live on both PC and consoles, grab your copy here: https://thqn.net/4apJEur
The Adventures of AngryJoe & OtherJoe in Gothic Remake, the complete update to the classic that started it all over 25 years ago! We show you what its like to play this hardcore RPG! 
Thanks to THQ Nordic for sponsoring this video! We plan to play more after finishing our the upcoming 007 Angry Review, no worries!
Experience the return of an oldschool RPG that helped shape the modern landscape of the genre.
